class.name: OcgBndOBB
class.brief_description: The class describes the Oriented Bounding Box (OBB), much tighter enclosing volume for the shape than the Axis Aligned Bounding Box (AABB). The OBB is defined by a center of the box, the axes and the halves of its three dimensions. The OBB can be used more effectively than AABB as a rejection mechanism for non-interfering objects.
class.description: ! The class describes the Oriented Bounding Box (OBB), ! much tighter enclosing volume for the shape than the ! Axis Aligned Bounding Box (AABB). !
